description: Enjoy a peaceful cruise through the bay at SkyBeach Resort Marina as the sun dips below the horizon. This relaxed outing is perfect for guests who want to unwind, watch wildlife, and capture sunset views from the water.

* Scenic sunset views over the bay
* Opportunities to see wild dolphins in their natural habitat
* Calm intracoastal waterways ideal for a relaxing cruise
